birth.definition: A source's assertion about a person's birth.

death.definition: A source's assertion about a person's death.

survival.definition: Evidence that a person was alive at a specified time.

residence.definition: Residence at a specified time; never an undated global home.

occupation.definition: An occupation, optionally bounded in time.

parenthood.definition: Parenthood, including an unnamed child; no gender inferred.

event_participation.definition: Participation in an event, with an explicit role.

other.definition: A sourced assertion awaiting a reviewed vocabulary term.

note: This is a pilot vocabulary, not a replacement of existing production enums. Null mappings are explicit extensions, not asserted RiC-O equivalences.
